name: elysia-rack
description: Model-driven CRUD rack for Elysia: REST + QUERY routes, validation, authorization, OpenAPI metadata, and React panel rendering.
author: notoofly

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:dts && bun run build:client
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/rack/index.ts ./src/react/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --splitting --external elysia --external react --external react-dom
scripts.build:client: bun build src/react/page/client/panel.ts --outfile dist/panel-app.js --target browser --format esm && bun build src/react/page/client/theme.ts --outfile dist/panel-theme.js --target browser --format esm && mkdir -p dist && cp src/react/app.html dist/app.html 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
